programme.title: Scared Shrekless
programme.desc: Halloween is coming.This year, Shrek's favorite holiday is going to be really scary.Instead of traditional fun, refreshments and tricks, the ogre challenges his friends.Together with Fiona, Donkey, Puss in Boots and other fairy tale characters, he plans to spend the night in Lord Farquaad's haunted castle.The atmosphere of horror is to be fueled by spine-chilling stories.The one who overcomes his fear will win the competition.Biscuits, Donkey, Puss in Boots and Shrek tell dark stories... In the Polish version, the characters are voiced by famous actors, including:Zbigniew Zamachowski (Shrek) and Jerzy Stuhr (Donkey).

programme.title: Eine Million Minuten
programme.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programme.title: Amrum
programme.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

credits.actor: Der alte Mann am Meer - Hark Bohm

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
programme.desc: Harry Potter spends the summer with the Dursleys in London.In the Muggle neighborhood, he and his cousin Dudley are attacked by Dementors.Soon, members of the Order of the Phoenix escort him to their organization's headquarters.Harry learns that the association was established to fight Voldemort.After the holidays, Potter returns to Hogwarts to begin his fifth year of study.A rumor begins to circulate about him that he lied and never actually met Voldemort.This time, Defense Against the Dark Arts is taught at Dolores Umbridge's school.As it turns out, the woman does not intend to practically prepare students to fight dark forces, because she believes that there is no need.Soon the teacher takes over the office of the school's grand inquisitor.Harry, sensing the approaching danger, shares his fears with Ron and Hermione.He secretly begins teaching selected colleagues Defense Against the Dark Arts.It soon turns out that he was right.

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: E Poi Si Vede
programme.desc: Three friends compete for an attractive job at the city hall.Federico relies on his father's connections, Fabrizio feels that he is born for this job, and Luca is always lucky.

programme.title: Broke
programme.desc: Former rodeo champion True cannot accept the end of his career.He is surprised by a violent blizzard.He fights for survival.

programme.title: Creator
programme.desc: Future.There is a war going on between humans and artificial intelligence.Joshua, a former secret service agent, suffers after the disappearance of his pregnant wife Maya.He undertakes the task of tracking down and eliminating the elusive Creator - an architect of advanced technology whose invention may end the conflict or destroy humanity.The Creator's new work, called AlphaO, threatens an American battle station used to fight AI.Joshua and a team of elite agents go behind enemy lines.He hopes that during the mission he will be able to find his beloved, because he received information that the woman may be there.While traversing the darkness of the occupied area, he discovers that the new weapon he is to eliminate is artificial intelligence hidden in the body of a child.

programme.title: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
programme.desc: 23-year-old guitarist Scott Pilgrim (Michael Cera) living in Toronto begins dating seventeen-year-old Knives (Ellen Wong).However, he soon meets the antipathetic Ramona Flowers (Mary Elizabeth Winstead), with whom he immediately falls in love.Regardless of anything, he decides to win the heart of the pink-haired stranger.To do this, he must deal with her seven exes, including:popular actor and skateboarder Lucas Lee (Chris Evans), vegan Todd Ingram (Brandon Routh) with extraordinary powers and musician Matthew Patel (Satya Bhabha).His task is made even more difficult by the rejected Knives, who is desperately trying to get her boyfriend back.The picture is based on the comic book series "Scott Pilgrim" by Canadian artist Bryan Lee O'Malley.The title character was played by Michael Cera, known from "Juno" and "Superbad".

programme.title: Joe Baby
programme.desc: A debt collector is to recover USD 10 million for a real estate entrepreneur.He becomes entangled in the world of crime and corruption.

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: African American Billie (Troy Leigh-Anne Johnson) is twenty years old and a tomboy.He comes from a military family and is missing one eye.After serving her prison sentence, she discovers that her separated parents are facing eviction.He decides to prevent this at all costs.The woman decides to rob a bank, but the action ends in failure.As a result, the young criminal takes her client hostage.Pregnant Franny (Grace Van Dien) is eighteen years old and has a head open to crazy ideas.Together they escape and set off on an adventurous journey.At one point, Franny offers Billie an unexpected deal.

programme.title: The Killer's Game
programme.desc: Joe Flood, one of the best contract killers, learns about an incurable disease and places a contract on himself.However, the murderess is targeting his ex-girlfriend.Joe decides to save her.

programme.title: Until Dawn
programme.desc: Clover and her friends go to the valley where her sister disappeared.They become the target of a murderer.Their story repeats itself every morning.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Knife
programme.desc: A year ago, teenage Winnie Carruthers (Jane Widdop) had to face a psychopathic murderer, Henry Waters (Justin Long), on Christmas Eve, whose victim was also her best friend.Now it's Christmas again in the town of Angel Falls.Winnie still remembers the tragic events, although her father David (Joel McHale) and other loved ones advise her to leave the difficult past behind.A misunderstood girl on a bridge on Christmas night makes a wish - she would prefer to have never been born.He then finds himself in a nightmarish parallel universe.He discovers that without her, everything could have turned out much worse.No one recognizes her here, she is a stranger even to her family and friends.And what's worse, Henry is still alive and the mayor of Angel Falls.The teenager must regain her former life and face a bloodthirsty murderer.A bloody variation on the famous Christmas classic - "It's a Wonderful Life" by Frank Capra.

programme.title: Hail Mary
programme.desc: Popular writer Maria (Laura Weissmahr) has recently become a mother.Her days are filled with caring for her son and visiting doctors.There is virtually no time left to create.To make matters worse, the husband keeps postponing the promised paternity leave and ignores the difficulties his wife is facing.At this time, Barcelona is shaken by information about the crime committed by a young French woman who drowned her 10-month-old twins in the bathtub.Maria follows this case with increasing attention, which slowly becomes her obsession.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie
programme.desc: A flock of colorful flightless birds lives on a quiet, exotic island.In this paradise community, there is no shortage of outsiders, such as the hot-tempered Red, the quick-as-the-wind Chuck, and the explosive Bomb.Unexpectedly, their happiness is interrupted by the appearance of mysterious green pigs.The picture impresses with its refined animation.Full of humor and positive energy, the production, whose plot refers to the popular smartphone game "Angry Birds", will appeal to both younger and older viewers.The film was directed by two debutants: Clay Kaytis and Fergal Reilly;and in the Polish version you can hear the voices of, among others:Jacek Bończyk, Janusz Zadura, Piotr Bąk and Marta Dobecka.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: The colorful flock of flightless birds and the cunning green pigs continue to quarrel and cannot stand each other's presence.Unexpectedly, however, they have to call a truce and forget about their disagreements.Their islands are threatened by a completely new enemy, whom they can only defeat by fighting side by side.Red, Bomba, Chuck and his sister Silver get along with Leonard and his crew.The second film inspired by a popular smartphone game.In the Polish language version, the voices were: Jacek Bończyk (Red), Agnieszka Mrozińska (Silver), Janusz Zadura (Chuck), Piotr Bąk (Bomba), Paweł Szczęsny (Leonard).

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
programme.desc: Harry Potter and his friends, Hermione and Ron, are starting their sixth year at Hogwarts.Magic school is no longer a safe place.The teaching staff is changing.Horace Slughorn becomes a potions teacher, and Severus Snape conducts Defense Against the Dark Arts classes.Meanwhile, Harry, supported by Albus Dumbledore, tries to learn about Lord Voldemort's dark past.The new professor can help with this, but he does not want to admit the mistake he made many years ago.Potter borrows a mysterious textbook that formerly belonged to the Half-Blood Prince.Thanks to the previous owner's notes there, he becomes top student in Potions classes.At the same time, he is preparing for a fight with the Dark Lord.Together with Dumbledore, he searches for horcruxes - magical objects in which Voldemort locked pieces of his soul.However, Harry does not know that his powerful enemy has a spy at Hogwarts.He was given a task by Voldemort.

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Paris, 1930s. The son of immigrants takes part in a theater performance.This is how he discovers his vocal talent and decides to become a singer.A breakthrough in his career was his meeting with Edith Piaf.

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: After an insidious attack by the Harkonnens and the death of his father, Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) and his pregnant mother, Jessica (Rebecca Ferguson), hide in the desert among the Fremen.There, a young man's feelings for Chani (Zendaya) sprout.At the same time, he matures spiritually.The leader of the wandering people, Stilgar (Javier Bardem), closely observes the only descendant of the Atreides family and becomes convinced that he is the chosen one, whose coming has been predicted for generations.However, to be accepted by the Fremen, Paul must pass the ultimate test by riding a monstrous worm.Meanwhile, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen (Stellan Skarsgard) finds out that Paul is alive.He knows he has to hurry.He decides to take control of the entire planet Arrakis.He starts launching attack after attack.A continuation of the spectacular production from 2021, which was awarded six Oscars.Both films are adaptations of the famous science fiction novel by Frank Herbert.

programme.title: F+
programme.desc: A family comedy aimed at teenagers.Ted (Wells Rappaport) and Josh (James Williams Jr.) are best friends and go to the Magnet School for Math and Science together.Ted is a star student, and Josh specializes in creating gadgets that they then use to prank others.After one of such antics, they are suspended.They must be careful because the next time will result in expulsion from school.The situation becomes more complicated when they fail the most important exam.The same fate befell Penny (Lily Jane), Ted's rival.Convinced that something was wrong with the test itself, they team up with a magician and a hacker to try to destroy the results during the school dance and give themselves a chance to improve.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The supporting penguin agents known from the three parts of "Madagascar" return to the cinema screen in their own production.Great entertainment for younger and older viewers guaranteed.Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private engage in a mission on which the fate of the world depends.They must face the geneticist Oktawiusz Mackiewicz, who dreams of controlling the Earth.In fact, the enemy of flightless birds is a vengeful octopus.It intends to settle accounts with visitors from Antarctica.Penguin agents join forces with the secret organization North Wind, which includes: the Greenland seal Detonator, the muscular teddy bear Kapral and the snowy owl Ewa.They are commanded by the mysterious Arctic Wolf, the Covert Agent.Good company awakens the competitive spirit in Skipper.As befits real superspies, the flightless unit travels halfway around the world.He visits, among others:Venice, Antarctica, Shanghai and New York.

programme.title: What Happens Later
programme.desc: The inveterate dreamer Willa (Meg Ryan) and the pessimist Bill (David Duchovny), who once had feelings for each other, meet by chance at the airport after many years.Their plans are thwarted by a massive snowstorm, which forces them to wait for the canceled flights to resume.They haven't seen each other for over two decades.She is a masseuse practicing spiritual rituals, he is a down-to-earth corporate employee.They didn't part peacefully, so even though a lot of time has passed, they have a lot of explaining to do.They start talking not only about their current lives, but also about their painful past.Willa is lonely, although she always wanted a family.Bill has a wife and a daughter, but not everything is perfect between them.Former lovers discuss why they went their separate ways.They wonder what would have happened if it hadn't happened.They have the opportunity to finally say to each other what has not been said out loud before.It turns out that they are still not indifferent to each other.Based on the play by Steven Dietz.

programme.desc: Young Peter Parker is fascinated by the Avengers team.He has the opportunity to experience an amazing adventure alongside his idols and unrivaled role models.After all, the teenager must return home and try to get used to his uninteresting everyday life as an ordinary mortal.He still lives with his good Aunt May, goes to college, and hangs out with friends.At the same time, he remains under the watchful care of Tony Stark, i.e. Iron Man - his mentor and greatest authority.He also tries to fight the pessimistic thoughts that plague him, that no one appreciates his activities, which bring so much benefit to society.Everything changes when it turns out that a new enemy is waiting for the superhero.One day, a dangerous Vulture appears on the boy's path.Peter must stand up for what he loves most.Not only are the lives of his loved ones at risk, but also those of other New York residents.

programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: Verano en diciembre
programme.desc: Four generations of women meet in Madrid at a convention organized by Teresa.She is accompanied by four daughters in their thirties, a granddaughter and her 95-year-old mother-in-law, who suffers from dementia.

programme.title: Veep 4
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).The entire team must contend with the ambitious Dan Egan (Reid Scott) and the confident White House employee Jonah Ryan (Timothy Simons).

programme.title: Veep 4
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).The entire team must contend with the ambitious Dan Egan (Reid Scott) and the confident White House employee Jonah Ryan (Timothy Simons).

programme.title: Frieda's Case
programme.desc: The year 1904. A seamstress accused of a crime becomes the center of a trial that exposes the injustices of the legal system.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The only companion of the lonely and malicious Grinch is the dog Max. The green creature only leaves the cave in search of food.Meanwhile, the residents of Whosiów are eagerly awaiting a special time of the year, Christmas.Wanting to keep the peace, the Grinch plans to spoil the grand celebrations and kidnap Santa Claus.At the same time, Cindy-Lou and her friends intend to capture a Lappish benefactor to thank him for helping the girl's busy mother.Two opposing intentions will face an inevitable confrontation.Another film adaptation of the adventures of a character created by a children's book writer, Dr.Seuss.Previously, Jim Carrey played the green creature in the 2000 film "The Grinch: No Christmas."In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Jarosław Boberek, Lila Wassermann, Ewa Prus and Karol Kwiatkowski.The carol was performed by Katarzyna Owczarz, Małgorzata Szymańska, Adam Krylik and Krzysztof Pietrzak.

programme.title: Tempete
programme.desc: Zoe (Carmen Kassovitz) grew up surrounded by horses in her parents' (Mélanie Laurent and Pio Marmai) racing stable.This is her place on earth.He dreams of one day becoming a jockey like his father.When a new foal is born, the girl is the first to notice its potential to become a champion.The family's life changes one tragic night, when a scared mare accidentally injures Zoe.The teenager, overcome with despair, completely breaks down.Thanks to the support of her parents and the help of the stable boy (Kacey Mottet Klein), who has an extraordinary gift for communicating with horses, Zoe decides to overcome adversity and regain what seemed lost.

programme.title: Tripped Up
programme.desc: Lizzy (Leah Lewis) has always dreamed of becoming a chef.However, participating in a culinary reality show and later working in a New York restaurant became a source of frustration for her.A cooking enthusiast is one step away from giving up her greatest passion.The last chance to stay in the catering industry is to participate in a culinary festival.Together with her friends, Mary (Ashley Moore), Kai (Ariel Winter) and Taylor (Sasha Fox), she sets off on an adventure.If she fails, she is ready to look for another path in life.Unfortunately, the team has been plagued by bad luck since the beginning of the expedition.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the island of Berk engage in fishing, sheep breeding and fighting dragons that regularly devastate their settlement.Frail Hiccup, the son of the tribe's chieftain, has no warrior's soul.He is a designer and inventor.However, he wants to be as good as his heroic father and, together with his peers, he takes part in classes on taming winged creatures.One day, using a launcher he constructed, he injures a representative of a rare species, a Night Fury.But no one believes him.The boy cannot kill a helpless creature.She secretly begins to care for him.She also names him Toothless.Over time, they become friends.The teenager decides to bring harmony between humans and dragons.Animation from the creators of "Shrek" and "Kung Fu Panda" nominated for two Oscars.A well-thought-out plot, excellent music and great Polish dubbing are the advantages of this wise story for the whole family.

programme.title: Eileen
programme.desc: 1960s, Massachusetts.Eileen Dunlop (Thomasin McKenzie) works as a secretary at a reformatory for teenage boys.She lives with her widowed, alcohol-addicted father (Shea Whigham), a former police chief who suffers from paranoia and emotionally abuses her.The girl feels overwhelmed by anger and a sense of helplessness.He seeks refuge in the world of fantasy.The arrival of a new prison psychologist, the assertive and self-confident Rebecca (Anne Hathaway), causes her suppressed feelings to come to life.It seems that for the first time he has a chance for a real, deep relationship... The film's script is based on the novel by Ottessa Moshfegh.

programme.title: Killer Heat
programme.desc: Greece.American Nick Bali (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) is hired to investigate the circumstances of the death of young shipping magnate Leo Vardakis (Richard Madden) in Crete.The deceased's sister-in-law, Penelope Vardakis (Shailene Woodley), does not believe the official police report.A private detective discovers that sunny landscapes hide many dark secrets and anyone can be a suspect.He discovers further facts about the rich and influential Vardakis family, as well as the brothers' complicated relationship.Adaptation of the story "The Jealousy Man" by Jo Nesbo.

programme.title: The Dark Wizard
programme.desc: Biography of the legendary climber, BASE jumper and slackliner.Dean Potter specialized in free solo ascents, speed climbing and slacklining without belays.An important element of his activity was crossing the boundaries of style and combining disciplines: climbing, highline and BASE jumping.He was the precursor of free BASE, i.e. solo climbing using a parachute as the only protection.In Yosemite he set speed and free solo records.His activities had a significant impact on setting risk limits, which raised ethical controversies in the community.He died in 2015 in Yosemite Valley.

programme.title: Kneecap
programme.desc: 2010. Liam (Mo Chara) and Naoise (Móglaí Bap) live in west Belfast.Growing up, they learned to speak Irish from the other's father, Arl (Michael Fassbender), who faked his own death to avoid repression from the British authorities and is now disillusioned with his son's hedonistic lifestyle.One night, Liam is arrested for drug possession.During interrogation, he refuses to speak English.So the police call in a translator, JJ Ó Dochartaigh (DJ Próvai), a music teacher at an Irish-speaking school.He helps Liam avoid charges and takes his notes with him.When at home he realizes that the lyrics are in Irish, he convinces the boy and his friend to start a hip-hop band, claiming that music would be a way to introduce the native language to the young generation.Liam names the group Kneecap.When the trio starts giving concerts, it turns out that crowds come to them.However, the musicians immediately begin to fall victim to sharp attacks from both the media and the extreme republican organization RRAD.Inspired by true events, the story of the creation of a popular Irish band.The main roles in the film were played by musicians who formed the group in reality.

programme.title: Gaslit By My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story
programme.desc: Morgan (Jana Kramer) is attacked by a masked assailant.A moment later, her ex-husband appears.His testimony raises concerns - has he come to help her, or is he hiding a dark secret?

programme.title: Eileen
programme.desc: 1960s, Massachusetts.Eileen Dunlop (Thomasin McKenzie) works as a secretary at a reformatory for teenage boys.She lives with her widowed, alcohol-addicted father (Shea Whigham), a former police chief who suffers from paranoia and emotionally abuses her.The girl feels overwhelmed by anger and a sense of helplessness.He seeks refuge in the world of fantasy.The arrival of a new prison psychologist, the assertive and self-confident Rebecca (Anne Hathaway), causes her suppressed feelings to come to life.It seems that for the first time he has a chance for a real, deep relationship... programme.title: Summer School, 2001
programme.desc: Kien returns to Cheb in the Czech Republic, where his relatives run a stall at the market.His appearance changes the family's life.

programme.title: The Glassworker
programme.desc: Vincent Oliver, the son of renowned glassmaker Tomasz, is preparing for his first exhibition when he finds a letter from his childhood friend, Alliz Amano, whom he has always loved.He recalls how - raised by a pacifist father - he saw her for the first time.Alliz arrives in Vincent's city, Waterfront, with her parent, Colonel Amano.They become a couple.Meanwhile, a war breaks out and both he and his rival for the girl's favor, Malik, join the army.Tomasz is forced to produce glass rectifiers for the army.Some time later, the girl's father dies without any news at the front.When Malik returns to town with him, Alliz rewards him with a kiss, which Vincent witnesses.Devastated, he sabotages the production of rectifiers, but this leads to tragedy.The anime-inspired production with an anti-war message is the first Pakistani film made using the hand-animated technique.

programme.title: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood
programme.desc: Lloyd Vogel (Matthew Rhys) is in crisis.His marriage to Andrea (Susan Kelechi Watson) is not going well.His son was recently born and he can't quite cope with the role of a parent.His wife, in turn, completely lost patience with his moods.He is also stressed by his relationship with his father, Jerry (Chris Cooper).She cannot forgive him for abandoning his family in the past and leaving him alone with his sick mother.Things aren't going well at work either.An aspiring investigative journalist is given a task by his superior that is below his skills.He is to prepare a short article as part of a series about inspiring people.He comes to interview the nationally beloved children's show host, Fred Rogers (Tom Hanks).Without any enthusiasm, he meets America's favorite, who immediately surprises him with his cheerfulness.Suddenly, the roles in their relationship are reversed.While it was Lloyd who was supposed to question Rogers, it was Rogers who steered the conversation and got him to confess.A friendship develops between the men.Under the influence of meetings with Fred, Vogel rediscovers the joy of life and begins to believe that he can repair relationships with his loved ones and experience happiness.A film inspired by a true story.

programme.title: Wolfgang (extraordinari)
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, nine-year-old Wolfgang (Jordi Catalán), an exceptionally gifted boy with features on the autism spectrum, is forced to live with his father, Carles (Miki Esparbé), whom he has never met before.An orderly nine-year-old who strives for perfection cannot stand his father's chaotic lifestyle.He wants to escape to Paris to study at the Grimald Academy and become the best pianist in the world.When Carles discovers his plan, he must make the most important decision in his life: follow his dream of an acting career or sacrifice his plans and become the father Wolfgang really needs.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programme.desc: Sarah (Margot Robbie) and David (Colin Farrell) meet at a friend's wedding.They go on an expedition during which they relive the most important moments from their past.

credits.actor: Father of the Bride - Mike Meldman

programme.title: Bird
programme.desc: 12-year-old Bailey (Nykiya Adams), her brother Hunter (Jason Buda) and her dad Bug (Barry Keoghan) live illegally in an abandoned building.The father doesn't have much time for the children.He is busy preparing for the wedding with his stepmother, whom they dislike, and looking for easy money.The mother became involved with an aggressive partner.Bailey also finds no support among her peers and becomes increasingly alienated.Her love for birds is her salvation.The girl spends more and more time alone in nature.One day she meets a tramp, Bird (Franz Rogowski), who asks her for help... Behind the camera, Andrea Arnold, director of "Fish Tank" and "American Honey" and the documentary "Cow".

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Southport, a fishing community in North Carolina.Four friends - Helen, her boyfriend Barry, Julie and Ray - are driving home from celebrating the Fourth of July.Suddenly, a figure in a fisherman's cape appears on the road.Barry, who is under the influence of alcohol, hits the brake too late.The young people decide not to notify the police about the accident and throw the body into the water.Their plans are not changed even by the fact that the victim shows faint signs of life.After returning home, they cannot recover.Julie becomes depressed.A year after the tragic events, the girl receives a blood-curdling anonymous letter.It reads: "I know what you did last summer."Soon the nightmare begins.A box office hit of horror cinema, which turned out to be a career ticket for the actors playing the main roles.A slasher based on the 1973 novel, written by Kevin Williamson, who proved his ability to scare by writing the script for "Scream".

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programme.title: Christmas In The Spotlight
programme.desc: The singer and the football player start dating before Christmas.The public is following the development of their relationship with interest.The couple must decide whether the affair will turn into a lasting relationship.

programme.title: All That Breathes
programme.desc: The brothers Nadeem and Saud live in one of the most densely populated cities in the world - New Delhi.They both devoted themselves to protecting a species of bird characteristic of the local ecosystem - the black kite.These majestic predators descend on city streets in large numbers due to the very high level of air pollution.Nadeem and Saud spend their days and nights washing and treating the birds in their makeshift hospital located in the basement.After recovery, they help the black kites return to their natural habitat.The painting was awarded, among others:at the Sundance and Cannes festivals and nominated for an Oscar.

programme.title: Barry 2
programme.desc: Further adventures of Barry Berkman, a former Marine and murderer who discovers his passion for acting.He is faced with the consequences of his previous decisions, including:murder of a friend.

programme.title: Barry 2
programme.desc: Further adventures of Barry Berkman, a former Marine and murderer who discovers his passion for acting.He is faced with the consequences of his previous decisions, including:murder of a friend.

programme.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
programme.desc: 1970s, Boston.Cam Stuart (Mark Ruffalo) suffers from bipolar disorder.Due to his illness, he had to be hospitalized and lost his job.One day, his wife, nurse Maggie (Zoe Saldana), accepts a scholarship to New York University.The MBA degree obtained there will help her find a well-paid job, thanks to which she will provide for her family and take care of her children's education.While staying in another city, her husband has to take care of his daughters - adolescent Amelia (Imogene Wolodarsky) and Faith (Ashley Aufderheide).He faces an exceptionally difficult task.Girls are often embarrassed by the behavior of their father, who keeps coming up with various unusual ideas.However, they help him face everyday challenges.

programme.title: King Charles III
programme.desc: After the death of Elizabeth II, her son Charles (Tim Pigott-Smith) takes over power in Great Britain.During his first meeting with Prime Minister Tristan Evans (Adam James), he learns about the draft law regulating the rights of the press, which has already been adopted by both the House of Commons and the House of Lords and is only awaiting the king's consent.Charles refuses to sign it, fearing that the new law will limit press freedom and allow the government to use censorship.Then, due to the prime minister's threat to introduce the law without royal consent, he dissolves parliament.Soon a wave of protests begins to sweep across the country, with the most violent taking place in London.The difficult situation at Buckingham Palace is not improved by a sex scandal involving the ruler's younger son, Prince Henry (Richard Goulding), related to the publication of compromising photos of him with his lover, Jessica (Tamara Lawrance).Charles's older son, William (Oliver Chris), and his wife Catherine (Charlotte Riley) also do not support the king.The young man accuses his father of causing the crisis and demands that he abdicate.A film version of Mike Bartlett's play of the same title.The author is also the author of the script for this production.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Poppy lives a peaceful life in her colorful and singing kingdom.One day he learns that beyond his borders there are other lands inhabited by trolls.Each of them has different rhythms.Just as she loves pop, the creatures inhabiting distant lands prefer rock, funk, techno, country and classical music.The curious queen, together with Mruk and other friends, sets off on a journey to meet and unite her kin.She will have to face the rebellious Barb, who wants to ensure that only rock rules in all lands.The continuation of the 2016 hit sticks to a proven recipe for success - a joyful, extremely colorful animation packed with great hits, showing the unifying power of music and the need for tolerance.The pandemic made the film go down in cinema history as the first high-budget production that went straight to VOD services, without a cinema premiere.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Magdalena Wasylik (Poppy), Piotr Bajtlik (Mruk) and Monika Węgiel-Jarocińska (Barb).

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.

credits.actor: Dr. John W. Thackery - Clive Owen

programme.title: Perry Mason
programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1931.The United States is in the depths of the Great Depression, but the City of Angels is booming.There is no shortage of oil, sound films or even the Olympic Games.The image of a beautiful and wonderful city is spoiled by one incident.There's a kidnapping that didn't go according to plan.The case is handled by detective Perry Mason (Matthew Rhys).It quickly turns out that it will turn his life upside down.An investigator uncovers Los Angeles's darkest secrets, and his search for the truth may allow him to redeem himself.A series referring to the works of Erle Stanley Gardner, author of the cult series about Perry Mason, criminal defense lawyer Los Angeles, 1931. A one-year-old boy, Charlie, is kidnapped.His parents, Matthew and Emily Dodson, receive a ransom demand - as much as one hundred thousand dollars.Attorney E.B.Jonathan enlists a private detective, Perry Mason, on the case.The investigators, together with their assistant Pete Strickland, direct their steps to millionaire Herman Baggerly.This man is on the council of the church attended by the parents of the abducted child.The detective tries to find out why the criminals set such a high sum, even though the boy's family is not wealthy.

credits.actor: Marcin Sarecki aka Black Hat - Matt Lasky

programme.title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
programme.desc: British actor, satirist and writer Brett Goldstein presents a monologue in which he shares his funny observations about love, sex, masculinity, but also "Sesame Street".

programme.title: Across the Universe
programme.desc: 1960s.Young Briton Jude (Jim Sturgess) goes to the United States in search of his father, whom he has never known before.The man is said to be a university lecturer.However, he turns out to be an ordinary worker.There, Jude meets a teenage American girl, Lucy (Evan Rachel Wood).They both fall in love with each other at first sight.Soon, Lucy's brother, Max (Joe Anderson), is drafted and goes to war in Vietnam.Meanwhile, Jude and Lucy, along with a group of friends and musicians, engage in anti-war activities.Their guides are: Dr. Robert (Bono) and Mr. Kite (Eddie Izzard).Together they fight for freedom of speech and civil rights.However, the tense situation is not favorable for lovers.Adversity tears them apart.They have to overcome many obstacles to be together again.The film's soundtrack included several songs by the legendary band The Beatles.The film was nominated for a Golden Globe (Best Musical) and an Oscar (Best Costume Design).

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Down with Love
programme.desc: The 1960s.Writer Barbara Novak (Renée Zellweger) comes to New York to publish her book To Hell with Love.The author convinces women to focus on their careers and treat sex and feelings the same way as men.Editor Vicki Hiller (Sarah Paulson) tries to set her up with the famous journalist, Catcher Block (Ewan McGregor), but none of the several meetings takes place.Eventually, Barbara's book gains popularity and becomes a bestseller.Then the roles are reversed and Novak rejects Block's subsequent proposals to meet.An angry journalist, whom the author called "the worst type of man" in a TV program, decides to take revenge on her.He begins to pose as astronaut Zip Martin to make her fall in love with him and ridicule her theory.He does not know that he himself is becoming an object of manipulation.

programme.title: Hacks 4
programme.desc: Another installment of the popular series, the previous three series of which were awarded, among others:four Golden Globes.The production is famous for its critical look at the world of show business.

programme.title: Sound of Metal
programme.desc: Drummer Ruben (Riz Ahmed) and vocalist Lu go on tour.A passionate musician realizes that he is losing his hearing.The life he loved begins to fall apart and the future is uncertain.

programme.title: Tony Hawk: Until the wheels fall off
programme.desc: The story of the world-famous American skater Tony Hawk.The film gives a broad look at the athlete's personal life and career, as well as his relationship with the discipline that the man has been synonymous with for years.Tony Hawk was the first in the world to perform a 900-degree turn and land correctly.He is also the author of many other tricks that are considered historical.The athlete also appeared in television programs and films, e.g. "Police Academy 4".The document included, among others:never-before-seen materials or interviews with other skaters.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Three stories about man's pursuit of immortality.16th century.In the forests of South America, Spanish conquistador Tomas Creo (Hugh Jackman), head over heels in love with Queen Isabella I of Castile (Rachel Weisz), is looking for the legendary tree of life for her.The ruler wants to use them to finally solve the problem of the power struggle with a certain high-ranking cardinal.In the 20th century, scientist Tom Creo (Hugh Jackman) tries to find a cure that will save his seriously ill wife Izzi (Rachel Weisz).A man cannot come to terms with the fact that his beloved is dying.He decides to devote himself to finding a way to overcome death.Six centuries later, astronaut Tommy (Hugh Jackman) travels through space in a glass ball.He wants to reach the golden nebula, hoping to bring Izzi back to life.A science-fiction drama by Darren Aronofsky, author of "Requiem for a Dream", "Black Swan" and "The Wrestler".

programme.title: River Wild
programme.desc: Idaho.Doctor Joey (Leighton Meester) goes to meet Brother Gray (Taran Killam), who is organizing a rafting trip on the Salmon River.There he meets his long-time friend Trevor (Adam Brody), who is on parole, and two young women.Initially, the rafting takes place in a relaxed atmosphere.Everything changes on their first night together, when the kayakers set up camp.One of the young women suffers serious injuries.The circumstances of the incident are unclear, and the injured party herself claims that she was the victim of an attack.The incident disturbs the peace of Joey and the other participants of the expedition.However, it turns out that this is only the beginning of the problems.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.desc: Called a phenomenon and showered with awards, the series "Glee" has forever become a part of the history of American television.Thanks to him, many young actors had an open door to their career.Unfortunately, for some it was the beginning of the end... Today it is known that fate hung over the cast of the show.The first tragedy occurred during the shooting.On July 13, 2013, the star of the production, 31-year-old Cory Monteith, was found dead in a hotel in Vancouver.The cause of death was given as a drug overdose.Then - three years after the last episode of "Glee" aired, in 2018 - the young actor's co-star, Mark Salling, took his own life.In 2020, the media reported the death of another artist associated with the musical, Naya Rivera.The creators of the documentary show the behind-the-scenes life of the cast of the hit, as well as, among others:conversations with Monteith's roommate and Rivera's father.Everyone is looking for an answer to the question: why the success of "Glee" turned out to be both a blessing and a curse.

programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia’s far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

credits.director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong
programme.desc: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekong’s banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the region’s abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators
programme.desc: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators
programme.desc: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe’s demise becomes a source of life for the region’s vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

credits.director: Hayley Smith, Caroline Hawkins, Clare Birks:Producers

programme.sub-title: Baby Sea Otter Finds a Family
programme.desc: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. They've also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants’ needs - and to see if they're returning to their natural corridors.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil
programme.desc: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials’ mealtime.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of history's greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Discover the world's largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spain's Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the region’s wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Learn how one of the world's most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: After a terrible accident at the nursery forest school, life changes drastically for nine-month-old Alejandra. And at forest school, the students enjoy a poolside classroom where Valentino proves he’s much more than just a class clown.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.\t\t.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

programme.title: Its In Our Nature
programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

programme.title: America's National Parks
programme.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses A visit to the most spectacular places in the United States.It was in this country that the first official national park in the world - Yellowstone - was created in 1872.Documentarians combined spectacular photos with engaging narration and music, creating a story about magical places and their inhabitants.In subsequent episodes, they discover the secrets of, among others, Badlands National Park in South Dakota and volcanic Hawaii.The beginning of their expedition is the park, whose unique landscape attracts approximately six million tourists from all over the world every year.Rocks teeming with life Grand Canyon National Park was established in 1919.Characteristic layers in the rock formations provide insight into the history of the Earth dating back millions of years.California condors nest here.Each of them is marked and monitored by scientists who managed to recreate the disappearing population.Cameras follow the growth of one of the predatory chicks - from hatching to its first flight.Viewers will watch the hunting of a fawn puma and an Arizona heloderma.They meet the inhabitants of the forest-covered Kaibab Plateau.They will see why the monumental rocks of the canyon were a sacred place for Indian tribes.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu reserve, a female leopard gives birth to two cubs and will do everything in her power to protect them.Progressing climate change causes resources to shrink, which leads to growing conflicts over territory.The film, which is the result of three years of careful observations, reveals previously unseen fascinating behaviors of these mysterious predators.Thanks to unique recordings, viewers can take a closer look at the fight for leopards' survival in a changing world.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savannah is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees: Season 1
programme.desc: National Geographic traveler and explorer, Bertie Gregory, takes viewers on a fascinating journey into the world of bees.For three years, the creators of the documentary conducted observations, using specialized cameras placed inside the hive to capture the life of these insects up close.The film reveals their complex architecture, social behavior and extraordinary intelligence of over 20,000 species of bees.They are responsible for pollinating one third of the food produced in the world and are considered one of the most important animals on our planet.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Materials showing spectacular events such as the collapse of bridges and buildings will be presented.The authors will explain how the disaster occurred.Was it the person or the equipment that was at fault?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of air accidents in recent years.Each episode will present a reconstruction of the events that led to the tragedy.The stories are supplemented by reports from experts and eyewitnesses.

programme.title: Lost Cities With Albert Lin
programme.sub-title: In the footsteps of the Templars
programme.desc: Fans of the adventures of Indiana Jones have the opportunity to see that reality is not inferior to film fiction, and scientists are constantly revising their knowledge about the past.The fabulous treasures of the Templars, the lost gold of El Dorado, the ruins of a city called the Venice of the Pacific, the holy places of the Incas and the mystery of Stonehenge - these are selected points on the map of Albert Lin's documentary journey.The scientist uses advanced technologies and various gadgets to see what was previously hidden from the eyes of archaeologists and historians.The legendary treasure of the order The exciting expedition begins in Acre in Israel - a strategic port city whose history dates back to the Bronze Age.A modern adventurer is looking for traces of the legendary Templar kingdom and its valuables.In the basement of a historic church, he meets Dr. Eliezer Stern, who is his guide to the heritage of brave knights from the 12th and 13th centuries.One can see what a brilliant engineering achievement the crypts equipped with huge water reservoirs were.While looking for gold that the monks obtained from pilgrims, he reaches a tunnel connecting the port with other districts of the city.Thanks to advanced technologies, it creates a map.Will it lead him to the treasure?

programme.title: Nazi Megastructures: Battle Ready
programme.desc: Profiles of engineers responsible for the construction of the most dangerous military facilities.Their works contributed to the technological revolution.The figures of Heinrich Himmler and Joseph Goebbels, who were completely devoted to Hitler, will also be introduced.The Führer assigned them the task of building the Nazi social machine.The program will also discuss the attack on the Soviet Union and the failure of total war tactics.You will be able to learn about the creation of the battleships Bismarck and Tirpitz, as well as the bunkers intended to protect submarines.In addition, the creators will talk about the conflict in the Pacific and the largest floating fortress armed with powerful guns.

programme.sub-title: Temujin: The boy who became khan
programme.desc: A profile of a man who went down in history as a brilliant military strategist.The six-episode series will present little-known facts from the life of the fearless leader.The authors will show how, after a difficult childhood and captivity, he managed to gain power, unite the quarreling tribes, build an invincible army and subjugate all those who opposed him, including his former allies.Impressive conquests will be discussed, including:expansion into the West, campaigns against the neighboring Tangut people and the Chinese Jin Empire.The troops he commanded were known for the mobility of their cavalry, carrying out rapid attacks and retreats, and applying psychological pressure on their opponents.They used innovative techniques during sieges of even well-fortified cities.Genghis Khan became one of the most important figures in history, expanding his empire to unprecedented sizes.It stretched from the Pacific to the Caspian and Black Seas.The creators of the series are based on a new translation of the anonymous chronicle "The Secret History of the Mongols", which is the oldest known monument of writing of the steppe peoples of Central Asia A fascinating history lesson that combines a story about the past with spectacular stagings like a blockbuster.The six-episode documentary series presents little-known facts from the life of the legendary leader, focusing on his subsequent conquests and centuries-old legacy.The authors based their work on a new translation of the anonymous chronicle "The Secret History of the Mongols", which is the oldest known written monument of the steppe peoples of Central Asia.The experts' statements are the background of a historical thriller in which the realities of the 12th and 13th centuries have been carefully recreated.Thanks to this, the distant past becomes vivid and exciting.A boy from the steppes The starting point of the story about the life of the founder of the Mongol Empire are the turbulent years of his youth.Temujin, later known as Genghis Khan, experienced the decline of his family, poverty and a life of insecurity.He witnessed the tribes fighting.Viewers will see how this survival school influenced his ambitions and character development.As a young warrior, Genghis Khan formed alliances to save his abducted wife, Börte.Thanks to the marriage, he gained the support of the Kereite chief.He consistently made decisions that allowed him to create the largest land empire in history.

Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: On April 26, 1986, an explosion destroyed the fourth block of the Chernobyl power plant.The accident was caused by design defects in the reactor and errors during the safety test.It was the worst nuclear disaster in history.The explosion released 400 times more radiation than the bomb dropped on Hiroshima.40 years after the tragedy, its consequences will be shown - from KGB activities to military operations in Ukraine.There will be plenty of witness accounts that will shed new light on the dramatic events.The speakers will include:liquidator working on the roof of reactor 3 and journalist Wyatt Andrews, who was covering the information blockade in Moscow On April 8, the remains of the fourth reactor were still unextinguished.The authorities finally decide to evacuate.50,000 people take supplies for three days.They don't know that they will never return to their homes.Meanwhile, firefighters with burns are being watched by the KGB.Swedish technicians at the Forsmark nuclear power plant are the first to detect increased levels of radiation.They alert the world about the catastrophe that the USSR authorities are trying to hide.Events two weeks after the explosion will be discussed.The authors will explain how attempts were made to hide the truth.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation 21
programme.desc: Reconstructions of real plane crashes.By recreating the course of events, the program's creators try to understand what led to the unfortunate events.They recreate the circumstances in which the tragedy occurred: the weather, the atmosphere on board the plane, the decisions and actions of the pilots.They also show the work of people investigating the causes of disasters and conduct a computer flight simulation.Viewers can hear various comments from specialists and testimonies of witnesses to these events.The creators of the program will prove that air accidents are often caused by human slowness and lack of imagination.Each disaster is thoroughly analyzed and the lessons learned help minimize the number of tragedies in the future.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: When astronauts blast off from the planet Mars, they leave behind Mark Watney, presumed dead after a fierce storm. With only a meager amount of supplies, the stranded visitor must utilize his wits and spirit to find a way to survive on the hostile planet. Meanwhile, back on Earth, members of NASA and a team of international scientists work tirelessly to bring him home, while his crew mates hatch their own plan for a daring rescue mission.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: People were forced to leave Earth a millennium ago to establish a new home on Nova Prime. Now, Gen. Cypher Raige (Will Smith) heads Nova Prime's most-prominent family. Cypher's teenage son, Kitai (Jaden Smith), feels enormous pressure to follow in his father's legendary footsteps -- which strains their relationship. Cypher and Kitai set out on a trip to mend their bond, but when their craft crashes on Earth's hostile surface, each must trust the other greatly -- or perish.

programme.title: Horizon Line

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent under cover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

programme.desc: For many years, humans have reported various UFO sightings around the world, fueling speculation about the existence of life on other worlds. It's up to a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon to draw a line in the sand against a powerful enemy unlike any previously encountered.

With his set of formidable skills, McCall comes out of self-imposed retirement and emerges as an avenging angel, ready to take down anyone who brutalizes the helpless.

programme.desc: Elaine's promotion of a mail room clerk sparks a mutiny; Jerry discovers his girlfriend's mentor is dating Bania; Kramer brings Frank out of retirement to cook.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry's fame in Japan endears Kramer to a group of tourists and inspires George to revive their TV pilot.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: As a restaurant's bright lights keep Kramer awake, Elaine's job is threatened after she buys George an expensive hat on the company's account.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: While abstinence makes George smarter, it has the opposite effect on Elaine; Kramer opens a smoker's lounge in his apartment as Jerry prepares to speak at a junior high school.

programme.title: Seinfeld

programme.title: Seinfeld
